featured_reviews.name: Moinuddin Ghameria
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an incredibly disappointing experience at Cat King. While the shop might have the supplies you need, the staff working inside are some of the worst I’ve encountered.
From the moment I walked in, I was treated with zero respect. The employees act as if they are doing you a massive favor just by speaking to you, treating customers as if we are trying to get products for free rather than paying for them. There is a complete lack of basic customer service etiquette, the staff is consistently rude, dismissive, and clearly doesn’t know how to treat people properly.
A retail business especially a pet shop should be a welcoming environment, but the attitude here is toxic. I’ll be taking my business elsewhere and suggest others do the same until they learn how to value their customers.
Owner of the store mr asad is the only one customer friend and good person he is the only one who knows how to maintain relation with customers.
And specially the lady staff acts like she is a boss over smart one.

featured_reviews.review_text: Great little shop with a solid selectio. They carry a lot of the premium brands that are hard to find elsewhere. The layout is easy to navigat and the prices are fair. Plus, the owner is incredibly nice and helpful. 10/10 would recommend if you're in the area."

featured_reviews.name: Fatima Attari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely disappointed with The Cat King.

I had booked a grooming appointment for my cat and paid a 100 booking fee in advance. Unfortunately, my cat fell ill on the day of the appointment and I had to rush to the vet. I even had a valid doctor’s prescription and was ready to share proof, yet the staff refused to either refund or even reschedule the appointment. The complete lack of empathy towards a sick pet was honestly shocking.

On top of that, booking appointments with them is unnecessarily difficult. They are extremely rigid with timings and never make any effort to accommodate customer preferences or help find suitable slots. It always feels like customers are expected to adjust entirely according to their convenience, with zero flexibility from their side.

For a business dealing with pets and pet parents, basic understanding and customer service should be expected — sadly, that is completely missing here. Definitely not an experience I would recommend.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The pet market in Mumbai, also known as Crawford Market, is a popular destination for pet lovers. The market offers a variety of pets for sale, including dogs, cats, birds, fish, and small animals like rabbits and guinea pigs.
While some visitors appreciate the variety of pets available at the market, others have expressed concerns about the welfare of the animals sold there. Some have reported seeing animals kept in cramped and unsanitary conditions, which can lead to health problems.
It's important to remember that pet ownership is a serious responsibility, and prospective pet owners should carefully consider their decision before purchasing an animal. It's also recommended to adopt from animal shelters or reputable breeders rather than purchasing from pet markets, to ensure that animals are well-cared for and treated ethically.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Just Cats Store and had a great experience.
The staff is very friendly and helpful, especially Aaro Sir and Utkarsh Mam—they were very supportive and guided me perfectly. The store is neat, clean, and well-maintained. They also offer good discounts on products. Highly recommended for pet lovers! 🐈🦮🐕

featured_reviews.review_text: Please check the items when scanned. They don’t charge right. I got it home trusting the computer scans they charged me Rs.120/ more. featured_reviews.name: Ahmed Alam
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm writing this review as a warning to others after my family's appalling experience at Pets Everyday. Not sure if he was the owner or salesperson. The salesperson behind the counter was incredibly rude to my dad, displaying a shocking lack of customer service skills. The salesperson's or owner's attitude was dismissive, condescending, and unhelpful. When my dad asked simple questions, he was met with eye-rolling, sarcasm, and a palpable sense of annoyance. It was like they were doing us a favour by acknowledging our presence. Pets Everyday clearly don't value its customers or prioritize their experience. The salesperson's or owner's behaviour was a stark reflection of the store's poor management and training. Unless you enjoy being disrespected and belittled, stay far away from Pets Everyday. There are plenty of other pet shops that actually care about their customers. Google doesn't allow us to give 0 stars. Otherwise, I would have given that.

featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing Place, people are very down to earth and helpful, I must say it is an one stop shop for all the pet needs... They also arrange products immediately if not available in the store.
